answer: Copies of the seed fragments are spread across several independent locations with enough redundancy that any quorum of them rebuilds the seed. The loss or theft of a minority of copies changes nothing, and no single site holds the whole secret. Rebuilding many fake identities would require corrupting a quorum of sites for each one. One wharf proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of continuity. The falcon hides nothing and the nectar reveals everything: the audit trail is open to all.
